proposal.reason: Main change is CI test orchestration: source-sanity/daily workflows expand PR case coverage (including new 810E 2-card/4-card splits and graphSearchTest cases), update case-generation/reconciliation inputs, and adjust CI build/staging scripts to produce and package required test binaries/artifacts. The broad .github/xtest path migration and test-list/data updates are supporting CI plumbing rather than runtime PCCL module behavior changes.
